title: Contents and article: a sticky table of contents (top-level items 600, nested 400, the section in view marked) beside the article column with a kicker, heading, paragraph and a footnote preview card
use: The reading chrome of a long paper: the section list that follows the reader and one section of text with its footnote card; count (5-8) sets the items and active the marked section.

active.note: the item marked as in view

toc_{i}.note: item i; items 4 and 5 are nested

para.default: 我们训练一个两层的小型 Transformer，输入是一段离散化的价格序列。为了读出它在算什么，我们在中间层的激活上训练一个稀疏自编码器，把激活拆成少数几个同时亮起的特征。

fn_text.default: 特征数取 4096，稀疏系数在示例中取 0.8。以上均为演示用的设定，不对应真实训练。

relations: Contents at x 96: a 28-unit bold heading, items every 44 units in 18 units (top-level 600 in the 80% ink, nested items 400 in the 60% ink and indented 22), the marked item in black with a 3-unit maroon bar to its left; a 1 unit rule on the block's right edge at x 516.

Article column at x 640, 780 units: a 16-unit tracked kicker, a 44-unit 600 heading, a 20-unit paragraph at 1.7 line height; the footnote card is 746 x 168 units in the beige with a hairline and radius 6, a bold 16-unit blue label over 17-unit text in the 60% ink.
decoration: The active bar and the rule are decoration; every line of text is a slot.

provenance.corpus: research-paper kit (examples/circuits-paper-kit): our own original interactive paper page in the circuits-paper grammar; all copy, features and numbers are labelled samples
provenance.experiment: styles/circuits-paper/style.json provenance (three public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The reference papers' sticky contents block and footnote hover card, set beside one article section.
measured: Contents: 516 px block, 1 px right rule, items 13 / 19.5 px, top-level 600, nested 400; hover card pale with small text and blue citation numbers.
Template: 5-8 items x every active item, light and dark pass.
